title: Amar Singh Reconciles With Baghel Singh

blocks.text: After Baghel Singh begins to withdraw, S. Chain Singh approached S. Baghel Singh and physically stops him from riding away in anger. He is brought back into Amar Singh's presence so that defeat can be transformed into a renewed bond rather than an enduring feud.

The reconciliation is marked through gifts, esteem, and kin-like language. Amar Singh goes so far as to offer to Baghel Singh for adoption his own son, symbolically recasting rivalry as a family alliance sealed in the idiom of Sikh fraternity.

The page closes by stressing that this was not empty ceremony. In later dangers Baghel Singh repeatedly acts to uphold the family bondage he had accepted, showing loyalty to Patiala when action, not words, became necessary.
